Vendored so bootstrap does not fetch GitHub.

- `voxprint_common-0.4.1-py3-none-any.whl`: the official v0.4.1 release asset from https://github.com/Mitroshenkov87/voxprint-common/releases/download/v0.4.1/voxprint_common-0.4.1-py3-none-any.whl (tag commit 0ea02df5a446e23a7c55ee9187ca96556ee96e01; sha256 `63ff6f3144a92d1de91dbb7c7c031d170fab2f5398b71c94e0e97bd89c93f764`, also in the `.sha256` sidecar). It bundles the same serial 9 signed model index as 0.4.0 (index head 15edeab, sha256 104742f9…f49e45f), the voxprint-model/1 schema (sha256 e46ae56a…5138), the voxprint-app-models/1 schema (sha256 ed451b99…c420), and our index public key (`keys/index-public.pem`). CI, docs, release builds and the Windows setup install it. The `gui` extra pins `voxprint-common[ui]==0.4.1`. `SUITE_APPS` includes `model-forge`. From 0.4.0, `paths.read_home()` no longer falls back to the legacy home (`%LOCALAPPDATA%\Voxprint`, `~/.local/share/voxprint`); the Windows setup moves it first (`installer/windows/migrate-home.ps1`), and Model Forge only uses `paths.home()`-based helpers, which migrate on first use.
